entities.name: Alphabet iQmethod Business Performance Table
entities.brief: iQmethod financial metric definitions and formulas.
entities.description: Standardised BofA methodology table for consistent cross-company financial analysis in the internet coverage cluster.

properties.table_content:
Business Performance                Numerator                                                                  Denominator
Return On Capital Employed          NOPAT = (EBIT + Interest Income) (1 - Tax Rate) + Goodwill Amortization    Total Assets - Current Liabilities + ST Debt + Accumulated Goodwill 
                                                                                                               Amortization 
Return On Equity                    Net Income                                                                 Shareholders' Equity 
Operating Margin                    Operating Profit                                                           Sales 
Earnings Growth                     Expected 5 Year CAGR From Latest Actual                                    N/A 
Free Cash Flow                      Cash Flow From Operations - Total Capex                                    N/A
properties.key_insight: iQmethod provides transparent, standardised formulas for measuring business performance across Alphabet and sector peers.

entities.name: Alphabet Return On Capital Employed
entities.brief: Alphabet’s ability to generate profit from capital employed.
entities.description: A key efficiency/profitability metric to compare Alphabet against internet sector peers.

entities.name: Alphabet Return On Equity
entities.brief: Reflects profitability for Alphabet’s equity holders.
entities.description: Material for investors tracking Alphabet’s shareholder value creation.

entities.name: Alphabet Operating Margin
entities.brief: Alphabet’s operating profit as a percent of sales.
entities.description: Crucial for assessing Alphabet's efficiency and comparing margins across the internet sector.

entities.name: Alphabet Free Cash Flow
entities.brief: Net operating cash after capital expenditures.
entities.description: Indicates Alphabet’s capacity for reinvestment, debt repayment, and distributions.

entities.name: Alphabet Earnings Growth
entities.brief: Expected compound annual EPS growth over 5 years.
entities.description: Forward-looking growth metric essential for valuing Alphabet vs internet peers.
